The '''Aratech Arrow''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] engine produced by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. It could be found in non-Aratech speeders, such as the [[Selanikio Sportster]]. A rebuilt Aratech Arrow in [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter's]] Selanikio Sportster was able to reach a top speed of 250 kilometers per hour.<ref name="ANH: The Life of Luke Skywalker">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>
